ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of RS-2 Residential Single-Unit

(Detached House) District symbols as shown on Map No. 10-K

in the area bounded by:

A line 230 feet north of and parallel to 45 Street; South Knox Avenue; a line 100 feet
north of and parallel to West 45 Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South

Knox Avenue.

To those of a RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 4438 S. Knox Avenue
